trap-negation-contrast.notes: RIGOR 1 (reported, MAJOR — a ring-membership claim that cannot hold). The block says the Markov traces and Gram entries 'are formal elements of Z[q^{+-1/2}, (q-q^{-1})^{-1}], hence elements of the Habiro completion Z[q]-hat'. The 'hence' fails: the Habiro ring Z[q]-hat = lim Z[q]/((q;q)_n) admits a well-defined evaluation at every root of unity, q = 1 included, whereas q - q^{-1} vanishes at q = 1, so (q-q^{-1})^{-1} cannot be an element of it (its evaluation at q = 1 would be 1/0). The half-integer powers q^{+-1/2} are likewise not in Z[q]-hat without an explicit extension. Proposed: either drop the 'hence' and say the data lie in a localisation that is NOT the Habiro ring, or name the actual target (e.g. a Habiro ring of the field the corpus uses, with the localisation and the square root declared). RIGOR 2 (reported, internal contradiction with a sibling): the opening sentence, 'The confinement LP selects the Borromean link B_3 as the UNIQUE optimizer over the 6-element NF basis of H_3(q)', contradicts the dated 2026-08-09 correction inside prf:operator-selection-lp, which states that under production convention D the Gram matrix on H_n is singular and the LP 'has a corank G-dimensional space of optima differing by radical directions the trace cannot see', with corank = 1 at n = 3. Uniqueness holds on the quotient H_3/rad tr_M = TL_3 (dimension C_3 = 5), not over the 6-element NF basis this sentence names.
